correctness.rationale: The memoryless simplex section law gives C=m(1-t)^m[∫_0^δ p(s)ds−(H_m/m)δ]. Strict monotonicity of the shifted-coordinate win probability p(s), including positive density of intercoordinate gaps, proves unique sign crossing. The t=1/m and t=1/2 signs are verified analytically. An exact integral of exponential maxima plus Gamma concentration yields m t_m=log log m+log log log m+o(1). The independent rational formulas agreed in 1089 exact tests; tests do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The largest spacing is an extreme-value statistic and the count of long spacings is a natural abundance statistic. The proved universal negative-to-positive covariance switch separates resource competition from extreme co-occurrence. Its unique crossover occurs on a double-logarithmic rather than ordinary log-m extreme-gap scale, supplying nontrivial structural information unavailable from separate marginals.
